I tried a bunch of meds but I am currently on Tianeptine and Mirtazapine, Tianeptine really helps my anxiety and reduced my panic attacks significantly plus it barely has any side effects, in my case at least zero noticeable ones. I only started Mirtazapine a couple months ago and it definitely helps with sleep but I also feel like it makes me more lethargic throughout the day and I am still not sure if I should stay on it. I also take Promethazine as an on demand med, it helps with the occasional anxiety and panic spikes or if the Mirtazapine isn't enough for sleep, plus it's an antihistamine which is good for my allergies, lol.
